links.comparator_used: the original, uncalibrated VPM baseline hazard (O/E ratio before recalibration vs after bootstrap-validated recalibration)
links.outcome: Ratio of observed to expected recurrence events (calibration)
links.effect: Original VPM O/E ratio 52/32 = 1.6 (95% CI 1.2-2.0), indicating underestimation; after recalibration of the baseline hazard, bootstrap-validated O/E ratio 1.03 (95% CI 0.55-1.74)
links.tradeoff: Recalibration was post hoc and validated only internally; authors state the recalibrated VPM should preferably be externally validated.
links.quote: Internal bootstrap validation of this recalibration step indicated an O/E ratio of 1.03 (95% CI 0.55–1.74) of the updated VPM.
